role: Actionable-steps half of AnalysisSummaryGenerator: post-exercise replacement steps, push gating (HRV signals + TrainingAdviceGate load), trend/training-load/score-band steps, morning-feeling divergence and per-tag advice; plus PostExerciseCopy and FeelingCopy sentence enums.
types: AnalysisSummaryGenerator.StepThresholds: enum (private) — the steps' own cut points (post-exercise drop 15 / TRIMP 20, high relative HRV 15% at score 70, feeling score 65, unstable-window efficiency 90, session readiness 30/50)
AnalysisSummaryGenerator.PushGates: struct — signals deciding whether push advice is safe
PostExerciseCopy: enum — readiness-band sentences after a workout
FeelingCopy: enum — morning-feeling / tag advice sentences
toplevel: No top-level code beyond the type declarations. The steps' own thresholds are named in StepThresholds; shared ones come from HRVThresholds.

units.does: Steps list: if currentReadiness exists, headlineScore >= 60, readiness < score − StepThresholds.postExerciseReadinessDrop (15) and todayTrimp >= postExerciseMinTrimp (20) → post-exercise steps only; else trend steps, training-load steps, score-band steps, then feeling steps inserted at the top.

branches.cond: currentReadiness set, score >= 60, readiness < score-15, todayTrimp >= 20
branches.effect: return postExerciseSteps (morning steps and feeling advice dropped); else morning steps

units.does: True when anything keeps the advice at moderate rather than high intensity: cumulativeLoadElevated, a loadHoldReason, no strong vagal tone, a fatigue signal or short sleep.
True when the TrainingAdviceGate level is .easier.
Gate reason sentence when the load level is .holdPush, else nil.

branches.effect: reasonLine (aboveUsual or monotonous sentence); else nil

units.does: Builds PushGates: HRV signals, advice load assessment, and shouldNotPush = short sleep or unstable window or fatigue or raised LF/HF or not consolidated or load level != clear.
result.isConsolidated, nil treated as false.

Computes RMSSD, stress/LF-HF/DFA (defaulted), window HR CV (default 0), strong vagal tone (pNN50 > 25 and RMSSD >= 40), unstable window (CV > 0.08), fatigue (DFA > 1.35 with strong tone, else > 1.2), raised LF/HF (LF/HF > 3.0 only without strong tone; a position of the ratio, not a sympathetic measure).

branches.effect: raised LF/HF forced false; else lfhf > 3.0

flags.text: A missing stress index, LF/HF or DFA α1 becomes 150 / 1.0 / 1.0, values that never raise a gate, so a night without those markers is pushed as freely as one whose markers were measured and settled.

units.does: TrainingAdviceGate assessment of the live load snapshot, falling back to the frozen trainingContext (caller's, else result's).

branches.effect: result's frozen context used as the frozen fallback

units.does: Trend steps (needs stats): improving-trend line when trend7Day > 0; high-relative-HRV blocked reason when rmssd > 15% above avg and 70 <= score < 80 (from 80 the score steps give the push or its reason, so it is not said twice); 'what changed' line when trend7Day < 0.
Below a well-recovered score: appends the blocked reason (appendHighHRVBlockedReason) when a gate blocks the push, else nothing. Never offers a push (TrainingAdviceGate.allowsPush needs score >= 80).

branches.effect: return without a step; else appendHighHRVBlockedReason

units.does: Blocked reason ordered by safety: cumulative load elevated (easier) sentence; else load hold reason; else today's-night reason.

branches.effect: append the gate's reason line; else appendHighHRVTodayReason

units.does: Today-only blocked reason: not consolidated with no other signal → 'pattern wasn't sustained'; short sleep; unstable window (efficiency >= 90 → 'moderate to high intensity should be fine', else moderate); fatigue; raised LF/HF → the ratio is above its usual resting range (breathing / gentle walk).

branches.effect: 'moderate to high intensity should be fine'; else 'moderate intensity' (nil efficiency treated as 0)
'LF/HF ratio is above its usual resting range' sentence; else nothing appended

units.does: Low-load steps from loadReading (live snapshot first, else frozen context — the push gate's source): ctl-qualified ACR < 0.8 → add movement; else ctl and atl both below ctlThreshold → 20-minute walk.
Score-band steps: >=80 well recovered, >=60 adequate, >=40 incomplete, else poor.
Well-recovered: blocked → capacity-without-readiness steps; else push and consolidated lines, plus good-sleep line when isGoodSleep.

Appends the blocked-push reason, then 'Consider moderate activity' when gates.capsAtModerate (load elevated/held, no strong vagal tone, fatigue or short sleep). The unstable-window reason it may follow offers moderate-to-high intensity only when nothing caps it, so the two agree.

Blocked-push reason for well-recovered scores: cumulative load; load hold reason; not consolidated (no unstable/fatigue/raised LF/HF/short sleep); short sleep; unstable window step (told whether the advice is capped at moderate); fatigue; raised LF/HF (ratio above its usual resting range).

branches.effect: 'pattern wasn't held long enough' (same order as appendHighHRVTodayReason)
'LF/HF ratio is above its usual resting range' sentence; else nothing

units.does: Unstable-window step: sleep efficiency >= 90 (nil treated as 0) and not capped at moderate → 'good shape for moderate to high intensity'; otherwise 'recovery wasn't fully consolidated'.
Adequate band: moderate-activity line plus short-sleep line or hydration line.

branches.effect: more-sleep line with duration; else hydration/sleep-habits line

units.does: Incomplete band: rest + light movement lines; plus sleep, sleep-quality, slow-breathing (LF/HF > 2.5) and stressor (stress > 200) lines when applicable.
Poor band: take-it-easy line; short-sleep or 'keep today light' line; clinician line when RMSSD < 25; hydration line; fragmented → uninterrupted-sleep line else extra-sleep line.

branches.effect: short-sleep priority line; else keep-light line

units.does: Morning-feeling divergence: feeling <= 2 → tag/generic feel-bad advice inserted at the top; feeling >= 4 with score < StepThresholds.feelingHRVGoodScore (65) → feel-good-HRV-low line at top.

branches.effect: insert feelGoodHRVLow; else nothing (feeling 3 or agreement)

units.does: Low-feeling advice: no tags → generic sentence; else unwell sentence first when .infection tagged, then other tag advice.

flags.text: docs/FLOWCHART.md describes the per-tag advice differently from the code: it says the advice is 'Appended to the analysis summary string' (code inserts it at the top of actionableSteps), 'Allergies → aerobic OK, monitor RHR' (code: 'Training is fine; expect reduced performance', no RHR), and 'Stressed + poor HRV → rest' (code: 'Reduce intensity, keep volume if possible').

units.does: Per-tag sentences in priority order: stomach, hangover, allergies, sore and tired (both skipped when infection tagged), headache, stressed, down.
Post-exercise steps: readiness label on the 0-10 scale, session-cost steps, plus a short-sleep carry-over line.
By readiness: < heavySessionReadiness (30) heavy-session steps, < moderateSessionReadiness (50) moderate-session steps, else light-session copy.
Heavy session: recovery, refuel, avoid-hard-session lines, plus sleep line when not good sleep.

branches.effect: append 8+ hours line (also fires when no sleep data)

units.does: Moderate session: good effort and rest lines, prioritize-sleep line when not good sleep, then skip-intense line.
Avoid-hard-session sentence chosen by the English readiness label.

Light-session pair: 'used some capacity — readiness is now ready' for label 'Ready', else the 'moderate' sentence (readiness >= 50 only yields Ready or Moderate), plus 'a light session later is possible'.
Feel-good-but-HRV-low sentence; 'great' for feeling >= 5 else 'good'.
Generic low-feeling sentence: HRV not good → signals agree, rest; else 'terrible' (feeling <= 1) or 'poor'.
Unwell sentence: HRV holding vs suppressed variant, both recommending rest and a doctor if severe.
Stomach-upset sentence.
Hangover sentence: HRV held vs suppressed variant.
Allergies sentence.
Sore sentence: good HRV → train other groups; else full recovery day.
Tired sentence: HRV holding → short session; else easy aerobic day.
Headache sentence.
Stressed sentence: HRV fine → exercise buffers; else reduce intensity.
Low-mood sentence: HRV fine vs suppressed variant, both pointing to someone to talk to.
